instruction: I'm used to scrolling on my phone and want the same experience on my laptop. Can you enable natural scrolling for the touchpad?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling natural scrolling for touchpad (phone-like scrolling). Config sets natural-scroll to false, instruction asks to enable it. The evaluator checks if the setting is true. Uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
